questions.questionHtml: If an 88-way set-associative cache is made up of 3232 bit words, 44 words per line and 40964096 sets, how big is the cache in Kilo bytes (1kilo=1024)?(1kilo=1024)?

Assume that a read request takes 5050 nsec on a cache miss and 55 nsec on a cache hit. While running a program, it is observed that 8080% of the processor’s read requests result in a cache hit. The average read access time is ________ nsec.
Which of the following statements about caches is (are) true?

options.textHtml: • A direct-mapped cache can have a lower miss rate than an associative cache of the same size (number of blocks).
options.html: • A direct-mapped cache can have a lower miss rate than an associative cache of the same size (number of blocks).

options.textHtml: • Programs with high spatial locality have a low cache miss rate primarily because the exact same addresses are re-referenced.

options.textHtml: • Programs with high temporal locality have a low cache miss rate primarily because the exact same addresses are re-referenced.
options.html: • Programs with high temporal locality have a low cache miss rate primarily because the exact same addresses are re-referenced.

options.textHtml: • In direct mapped cache, there is no need of page replacement algorithm.
options.html: • In direct mapped cache, there is no need of page replacement algorithm.

questions.questionHtml: The designers of a cache system need to reduce the number of cache misses that occur in a certain group of programs. Which of the following statements is/are true?

options.textHtml: • If compulsory misses are most common, then the designers should consider increasing the cache line size to take better advantage of locality.
options.html: • If compulsory misses are most common, then the designers should consider increasing the cache line size to take better advantage of locality.

options.textHtml: • If capacity misses are most common, then the designers should consider increasing the total cache size so it can contain more lines.
options.html: • If capacity misses are most common, then the designers should consider increasing the total cache size so it can contain more lines.

options.textHtml: • If conflict misses are most common, then the designers should consider increasing the cache's associativity, in order to provide more flexibility when a collision occurs.
options.html: • If conflict misses are most common, then the designers should consider increasing the cache's associativity, in order to provide more flexibility when a collision occurs.

options.textHtml: • If capacity misses are most common, then the designers should consider increasing the cache's associativity, in order to provide more flexibility when a collision occurs.
options.html: • If capacity misses are most common, then the designers should consider increasing the cache's associativity, in order to provide more flexibility when a collision occurs.
